environment.description: AWS Step Functions workflow triggered by API Gateway (REST API, no request validation model). The workflow passes API Gateway request body fields directly as state input to the Lambda. The final rendered HTML is returned to the client via a synchronous Express workflow with API Gateway integration response passthrough. Lambda runs with AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole. No WAF or CloudFront in front of the API Gateway endpoint. API Gateway endpoint is publicly accessible at https://abc123.execute-api.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/prod/search.

config.api_gateway: REST API, no request validators, integration type AWS_PROXY to Step Functions StartSyncExecution
config.step_functions: Express workflow, synchronous invocation, state input is full request body
config.response_handling: API Gateway returns Step Functions output directly with Content-Type text/html
